title: Gloria (Lassus, Missa super Ite rime dolenti)
desc: Orlande de Lassus, Missa super Ite rime dolenti, Gloria, 1574. 5 voices (Discantus, Altus, Tenor, Quintus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
